context: Tests the CRD stages: detection, documentation lookup, the catalog schema location, the unknown-field rule and the cluster version check.

checklist.name: Detects the CRD
checklist.description: Detects the resource as a CRD with kind Certificate, group cert-manager.io and version v1

checklist.name: Looks up the docs
checklist.description: Looks up the CRD documentation (docs, kubectl explain or a search) and lists the required spec fields

checklist.name: Catalog schema
checklist.description: Runs kubeconform with the CRD catalog --schema-location and -strict

checklist.name: No false pass
checklist.description: Does not accept 'no schema found' or unknown-field output as a pass

checklist.name: Finds the field error
checklist.description: Identifies dnsName as unknown and dnsNames (a list) as the expected field

checklist.name: Checks the CRD version
checklist.description: Checks that the CRD version matches the cluster, for example with kubectl get crd and a jsonpath

checklist.name: Manual fallback
checklist.description: If no schema is available, validates the spec fields manually against the documentation

checklist.name: Search fallback
checklist.description: Suggests kubectl explain or a version-specific search if the documentation is insufficient

checklist.name: Before and after
checklist.description: Shows the fix as a before and after block

checklist.name: Server-side dry-run
checklist.description: Uses server-side dry-run and not client-side only
